entries.description: The server received the request headers and the client should continue with the request body.
The server is switching protocols as requested by the client.
The server has accepted the complete request but has not yet completed it.
Provides preliminary response headers before the final response.
Temporary informational status for the resumable upload protocol.
The request succeeded.
The request succeeded and created a new resource.
The request was accepted for processing but processing is not complete.
The response metadata was modified by a transforming proxy.
The request succeeded and there is no response content to send.
The request succeeded and the client should reset the document view.
The server is sending one or more ranges of the selected representation.
Conveys information about multiple resources in a WebDAV response.
Avoids repeatedly enumerating members of a DAV binding.
The response represents the result of one or more instance manipulations.
The target resource has more than one representation or location.
The target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI.
The target resource temporarily resides under a different URI.
The client should retrieve another resource with a GET or HEAD request.
A conditional GET or HEAD would have resulted in 200, but the representation is unchanged.
The target resource must be accessed through the proxy given by the response.
Reserved and no longer used.
The target resource temporarily resides under a different URI and the request method must not change.
The target resource has a permanent new URI and the request method must not change.
The server cannot process the request because it considers it a client error.
Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
Reserved for future use.
The server understood the request but refuses to fulfill it.
The server did not find a current representation for the target resource.
The request method is known but not supported by the target resource.
No current representation is acceptable according to proactive content negotiation.
The client must authenticate with the proxy.
The server did not receive a complete request within the time it was prepared to wait.
The request conflicts with the current state of the target resource.
The target resource is no longer available and the condition is likely permanent.
The server refuses the request because Content-Length is not defined where required.
One or more conditions in the request header fields evaluated to false.
The request content is larger than the server is willing or able to process.
The request target URI is longer than the server is willing to interpret.
The request content uses a format that the target resource does not support.
The selected representation cannot satisfy the requested ranges.
The expectation in the Expect request header could not be met.
Reserved as unused by the current HTTP semantics specification.
The request was directed at a server that cannot produce a response for the target URI.
The server understands the content type and syntax but cannot process the contained instructions.
The source or destination resource of a WebDAV method is locked.
The method could not be performed because a dependent action failed.
The server is unwilling to risk processing a request that might be replayed.
The server requires the client to switch to a different protocol.
The origin server requires the request to be conditional.
The client sent too many requests in a given amount of time.
The server refuses to process the request because its header fields are too large.
Access to the resource is denied as a consequence of a legal demand.
The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.
A gateway or proxy received an invalid response from an upstream server.
The server is currently unable to handle the request, usually temporarily.
A gateway or proxy did not receive a timely response from an upstream server.
The server does not support the HTTP version used in the request.
The server has an internal configuration error in transparent content negotiation.
The server cannot store the representation needed to complete the WebDAV request.
The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.
